spec_match.rationale: Side-by-side map panes with scroll-axis-lock: auto vs none and a plotted scroll trail with straightness/axis-change metrics.

interactive.rationale: "Draw the straight line" and "Back to the depot" work and the trail/metrics update from real scroll events.

edge_cases.rationale: No guidance for mouse-wheel/keyboard users, for whom axis locking never applies.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Suite 6/6 PASS on parsing, invalid-keyword rejection and initial value, but nothing (automated) proves the gesture behaviour; that is inherent to a UA-gesture feature and should be stated as a manual-observation contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): buttons exercised and console clean, but synthetic diagonal touch gestures did not scroll the panes; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Inline styles use the design-system variables; button overrides keep text/background pairs readable; not a static card.

accessibility.rationale: Native, labelled controls (no unnamed controls found), visible focus on a Tab walk, and results surfaced as text in status/output regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360×740 documentElement.scrollWidth === innerWidth (wide content scrolls inside its own container) and desktop 1280×800 lays out cleanly.

openQuestions.title: Capture real touch/trackpad evidence for the locked vs unlocked panes
openQuestions.detail: The panes only differ under a real UA gesture. This pass tried CDP Input.synthesizeScrollGesture (touch, diagonal) on both panes and the scroll offsets did not move, so neither the L-shaped auto trail nor the diagonal none trail was observed. Record a real-device (Android Chrome / trackpad) run, and label the page state as manual observation where no gesture input exists.

guidanceConsulted.query: scroll container panning touch gesture overscroll behavior
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: For maps/canvases/grids allow free two-dimensional panning and avoid accidental axis capture; contain overscroll.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Observed: the demos contrast scroll-axis-lock:auto vs none on 2D map/board panes, which is the recommended use.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx -y modern-web-guidance@latest search "scroll container panning touch gesture overscroll behavior" (run 2026-11-15)

summary: Critique-only pass. Loaded http://localhost:3109/v153/scroll-axis-lock/diagonal-pan/ in Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass), clicked/changed every visible control, captured console errors and failed requests, checked 360px horizontal overflow and a Tab focus walk, and ran /v153/scroll-axis-lock/conformance/ (unflagged, and with the relevant --enable-blink-features flag where one exists). Non-minor work items are listed in openQuestions.
